Practice

Critique:

Describe, analyze and interpret a classmate’s self-portrait.

Take notes, and assemble your thoughts for an oral presentation of your classmate’s project. Note your first overall impression, then describe what is

there. Next, analyze the visual relationships you see. Finally use these observations to support your interpretation of the portrait. Your conclusion should also describe any ambiguity or aspects of the portrait that you find confusing.

Does the portrait succeed in identifying the person? Does it suggest aspects of the person beyond this resemblance?
The class is divided into 5 groups, each group choose 1 chapter to read and prepare presentation slides for the next lesson
